task_description: Improve site loading performance by adding aggressive caching headers in next.config.ts, reducing critical preloader frames from 150 to 50, adding Next.js image optimization config, setting Vercel-specific cache headers, and implementing a service worker for frame sequence caching.

verification.summary: npm run build passes cleanly. No test framework in project. Only pre-existing lint warnings (unrelated img element usage). All static pages generated successfully.

review_fixes.summary: Fixed two confirmed issues from review: (1) Added .catch(() => fetch(event.request)) to SW respondWith promise chain to fail open on cache errors, (2) Changed broad extension cache rules from immutable/1yr to max-age=86400 with stale-while-revalidate=31536000 for gallery images.
